why: Final decision. Downward camera shows the blue-taped target mat, but it's off-center toward the bottom-right of frame (behind and to the right of the drone) and the plush itself isn't clearly visible under the propeller shadow -- we likely overshot it slightly on the last move. Policy proposes a further translate plus a large 50.8deg yaw turn (trust only 0.28), which risks losing the target entirely on the last frame. Overriding with a small corrective nudge back and right, slight descend, no yaw, to settle as centered over the target as possible for the final hover.
